Create a SQL query to select the top 5 customers whose address is in the USA and have made at least 50 purchases in the last week, and order the result by the total amount spent by the customer in descending order.

SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_spent
FROM purchases
WHERE address LIKE '%USA%'
AND purchase_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING COUNT(purchase_id) >= 50
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;
